baseline.scope: Single central block; split blocks contain different surfaces. This is a conservative regression screen, not a paired statistical equivalence test.

justification.block_mae: 1.359 + 0.300 m. Reuse the existing fixed rule's 0.3 m maximum class regression budget (docs/TRAINING_FINDINGS.md), applied here to each block's all-labelled MAE. Existing recipe measurements are 1.359 m (pipeline 19v) and about 1.38 m (authors 17v); these are different datasets, not replicate runs. No same-input run-to-run variance estimate exists; 0.3 m is a policy tolerance, not a confidence interval.
justification.seam_mae: Allow at most 0.5 m additive degradation versus that block's >10 m interior. This budget is of the order of the prior 0.50 m gain from 3-view to 5-view (3.32 to 2.82 m) and is below the 1.458 m gain from 5-view basic to 19-view recipe. It must not erase the demonstrated gain. dsmr's finest NCC step is one 0.5 m truth pixel (integer compute_ncc); this is a horizontal sampling scale, not a proof of 0.5 m vertical uncertainty. No replicate seam measurements exist.
justification.height_step: Ground: 0.5 m, comparable to the previously measured 0.2-0.6 m vertical placement uncertainty of the original pilot (tasks.md). All pixels: 1.0 m, allowing some building/vegetation composition difference while staying below the 1.359 m baseline shape MAE. Measure raw ellipsoidal DSM strip medians, without independently registering away vertical offsets. Also report lidar's own strip step and registered/residual strip steps for interpretation. Natural terrain or class composition can fail this conservative rule; do not retune thresholds after training.
justification.ownership: Exact half-open cells in one shared ENU frame admit neither overlap nor gap. Millimetre tangent-plane mismatch is avoided rather than tolerated. Counts refer to centres, not Gaussian kernel support or opacity overlap. Mixed-LOD visual continuity remains a separate future check.

measurement.all_labelled: Finite lidar, CLS != 65 and CLS != 9; same exclusion as dsm_validation.
measurement.height_all: All finite lidar and predicted pixels, including water and unlabelled pixels; ground uses CLS=2.
measurement.registration: Each block uses unchanged dsmr horizontal shift plus vertical offset; seam-band and interior MAE use registered DSM. Height continuity uses unregistered ellipsoidal heights.
measurement.empty_samples: Fail/inconclusive, never zero error. Report counts and completeness for every subset.
measurement.holdout: May 2 is excluded from SfM, training, pseudo views and every choice. Evaluate only after training; PSNR is descriptive and does not choose thresholds or settings.
measurement.approval: Stage B GPU training requires separate user approval (~84.2 minutes from 2 x 42.1-minute 19v recipe measurement). No GPU jobs in Stage A.
